name: import-ai-memory
description: Pulls what ChatGPT or Claude already knows about the owner into the campus, without waiting on a data export. Hands the owner a prompt to paste into that app; the model writes out its memory of them; the result lands in inputs/intake/ as raw material for /campus-intake. Use when the owner says "/import-ai-memory", "import my ChatGPT memory", "get what Claude knows about me", or during /campus-intake Phase 1. Re-runnable any time their thinking has moved on.
